name: Sticky Docs Sidebar
note: A two-column grid inside one scroller keeps the nav rail position:sticky with align-self:start, and a rAF-throttled scroll handler compares section offsetTop against the scroller position to set aria-current.
html:
Contents v4 · 5 min

Install

The SDK ships ESM and CJS builds and runs on Node 18 or newer. No native modules, no post-install step.

npm i @northwind/sdk

Authenticate

Server keys start with nw_live_ and belong to one environment. Rotating a key from Settings keeps the old one valid for sixty minutes, so deploys never race.

const nw = createClient(process.env.NW_KEY)

Webhooks

Every event is signed with an HMAC over the raw body. Verify before parsing, then answer 2xx within five seconds; slower replies are retried six times on an exponential curve.

nw.webhooks.verify(req.rawBody, sig)

Rate limits

600 requests per minute per key, with a burst of 60 that refills every second. The remaining budget is returned on every response header, so back off before you are throttled.

Errors

Failures carry a stable machine code plus a human message. Branch on the code; the message is written for your logs and may change without notice.

{ code: "card_declined", retryable: false }

name: Pinned Pipeline Figure
note: The diagram column is position:sticky beside a scrolling explanation, and a scroll handler picks the step crossing the scroller's upper third to light its layer and slide the beam by a stepped custom property.
html:
Stage 01

Edge accepts

The nearest point of presence checks the signature and appends the payload to a durable log. Nothing is parsed yet, which is why it answers in twelve milliseconds.

Stage 02

Queue absorbs

Bursts land in a partitioned stream keyed by account, so one noisy tenant can never block the accept path for everyone else.

Stage 03

Worker transforms

Records are normalised, deduplicated by idempotency key and enriched from the account cache. This is the only stage allowed to fail loudly.

Stage 04

Store commits

The row is written exactly once and a receipt is emitted to your webhook endpoint with the trace id attached.

Every stage emits a span, so a slow request can be read end to end in the trace viewer.

name: Sticky Reading Bar
note: The sticky toolbar's hairline is driven by a CSS scroll() timeline where supported and by a custom property written from the scroller's own scroll event everywhere else, while the same handler names the section and reveals the back-to-top control.
html:
Why we rebuilt the grid 0%

Why we rebuilt the grid

Engineering · 6 min · 14 Aug

The old table repainted every cell on every keystroke. At four hundred rows nobody noticed. At forty thousand the filter box turned into a slideshow.

The cost of a virtual row

Virtualisation is usually sold as a free win. It is not. You trade layout cost for bookkeeping, and the bookkeeping has to be cheaper than the paint you removed, or you have simply moved the bill.

So we measured first. Ninety per cent of the frame budget went to recalculating column widths that had not changed since the page loaded.

Freezing the geometry

Widths are now resolved once per dataset and cached against a shape key. Dragging a column invalidates that one key instead of the whole grid.

Headers moved into the scroller as sticky elements, so the compositor holds them in place rather than us rewriting a transform on every frame.

What it bought us

Filtering forty thousand rows settles in fourteen milliseconds, and the grid holds sixty frames a second while a column is dragged. The module is also a third shorter than the one it replaced.
